title: VLP Extraction from Fecal Samples
author: Frej Larsen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2qaqdse
materials: Thaw frozen sample in ice bucket

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Buffer
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 500 mg of sample to a centrifuge tube and add SM buffer to reach a final volume of 5 mL, then place the tube back in an ice box.

steps.title: Homogenize Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize the samples by placing the ice box on a shaking board at 300 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 5000 rcf and 4 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Filter Supernatant
steps.instruction: Filter the supernatant through a 0.45 um PES filter into a new centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Concentrate Sample
steps.instruction: Concentrate the sample using a concentrator until all liquid from the centrifuge tube has passed through.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2.5 mL of the sample to the outer chamber of the concentrator
Centrifuge the sample in the concentrator at 1500 rcf, 4 °C, for 20 minutes
Pour off liquid from the inner chamber
Repeat these steps until all liquid from the centrifuge tube has passed through and no liquid remains in the inner chamber

steps.title: Wash and Recover VLPs
steps.instruction: Wash the filter and allow VLPs to release before further processing.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 ul SM buffer to the inner chamber and centrifuge at 1500 rcf, 4 °C, for 2 minutes
Leave in the fridge to release VLPs from the filter for at least 12 hours and at most for 1 week
